data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for over-the-air updates, downloading and installing APKs on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides over-the-air (OTA) updates for Android by downloading the file with progress reporting and triggering app installation intents. Also supports a PackageInstaller method and silent updates for system apps.
use_when: You need to implement in-app self-updates (OTA) for Android applications.
You need download progress reporting during the update file retrieval.
You are building system apps, kiosk apps, or custom Android ROMs requiring silent installation.
avoid_when: You are publishing primarily through official stores like Google Play which handle updates automatically.
You need fully functional iOS OTA updates out of the box (iOS safari redirection is currently not functioning).
strengths: Supports download progress reporting via streams.
Supports SHA-256 checksum verification to ensure file integrity.
Supports silent installation for system apps.
weaknesses: iOS support is currently not functioning.
Requires manual setup of Android permissions, FileProvider, and core library desugaring.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling core library desugaring in build.gradle, adding AndroidManifest permissions, FileProvider, and InstallResultReceiver.
